scope: Fail-closed plan-generation guard for retained Full128 engineering work; not a dispatch approval or scientific result.
source_run_cardinality: Exactly one source run is accepted by this compiler revision. Any later retained run requires a reviewed compiler revision before a new target window can be compiled.

source_run_schema.coverage_rule: The r9 range is fixed independently to [1,10). Dispositions must appear exactly once in canonical population order for every index in that range.
source_run_schema.evidence_rule: The dedicated reconciliation builder reads the exact retained research-harness state snapshot and derives all nine dispositions from its task map; it accepts no caller-authored status list. The compiler independently rehashes and parses the retained campaign, aggregate status and harness state; recomputes the canonical harness plan digest; resolves every task's exact path/sha256 native-plan reference beneath the archived campaign root; and recomputes each native plan digest. It requires matching run ID, fixed plan digest, task IDs 001 through 009, native-plan paths, status indices, observation time, disposition counts and each individual task status. The validated historical JSON files are staged as opaque byte-pinned evidence so their original run-relative inner paths cannot be rebound against the current project root. Aggregate-only status, swapped per-task states, claimed digests, path-only native references, changed native files, arbitrary same-hash files or pricing-only references are rejected.

canonical_builder.precondition: The exact r9 state snapshot must first be copied without modification to required_state_snapshot_path and retained with the matching campaign/status snapshot. The builder fails closed while that file is absent.

plan_generation_rule: A target window is rejected when any target UID appears in any retained source-run disposition, regardless of outcome. This prevents success-selected omission, retry of a natural failure, or duplicate live work.
nonoverlap_rule: A nonoverlapping target may be compiled only after the sole required r9 source run and its complete retained range are present, the campaign digest recomputes, and every campaign, status and native-plan reference resolves with matching SHA-256.
freshness_rule: The observation timestamp describes the evidence snapshot used for plan generation. It does not prove later liveness and cannot authorize dispatch; Local must re-reconcile host state immediately before any execution approval.
